evidence.title: Retrieval scoring overview
evidence.content: The retrieval pipeline combines a vector similarity component with a lexical overlap component, weighted by token coverage. Top-k chunks are returned in descending score order, with the median ratio surfaced as a downstream signal.

evidence.title: Scoring signals
evidence.content: Beyond the headline score, the pipeline tracks query token coverage, title match, distinct sources, and a median ratio. Combined these support an off-target predicate the runtime uses to decide whether retrieval landed.
